meta.name: financial-statement-analysis
meta.description: Reads a set of financial statements and establishes what changed and why — fluctuation analysis against prior period and against budget, profitability, liquidity, solvency and efficiency ratios, benchmarking, and the non-GAAP measures presented alongside them. Use this to interpret results, review a counterparty's or target's financials, diagnose a deteriorating trend, explain a variance to someone who will act on it, or test whether an adjusted number is honest.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 分析财务报表,解释变动原因与财务健康度
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想快速看懂一家公司的财务报表并发现异常变动。
copy.tagline_en: Analyze financial statements to uncover changes and assess financial health.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to interpret financial statements and explain variances to decision-makers.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会同时对照利润表、现金流量表和资产负债表,解释现金与利润之间的缺口;根据上期和预算逐项分析变动原因(如数量、价格),计算盈利等比率并与同行或内部对标,还会检验公司披露的“调整后”盈利数字是否真实。
howto.when: 当你给出一组财务报表,并想弄明白数字变动原因、判断公司财务是否稳妥,或核验调整后数字是否可信时。

say.text: 这是近几年的年报,请对比上期和预算,解释为什么净利润涨了但现金流却下降。
say.note: 它会找到净利与现金流背离的原因,并看营运资金是否吸走现金。

say.text: 帮我审查这家供应商的财务报表,评估它未来一年会不会出现资金链问题。
say.note: 它会评估流动性、偿债能力,并与同业比较,给出风险提示。

say.text: 公司把重组费从调整后利润中剔除了,请核查这个调整是否合理。
say.note: 它会审视剔除项目是否为一次性费用,并检查能否与法定利润对账。

howto.what_en: Reads all statements jointly; explains profit-cash divergence, variance vs prior period/budget, and benchmarks ratios, while checking non-GAAP numbers.
howto.when_en: When you supply financial statements and want to know why figures changed, whether a company is financially sound, or whether adjusted numbers are trustworthy.

say_en.text: Why did net income rise but cash flow fall? Compare with prior year and budget.
Assess this supplier's statements. Will it face a cash crunch in the next year?
say_en.note: Checks ratios, liquidity and solvency vs industry.

say_en.text: Is excluding restructuring costs from adjusted profit legitimate?
say_en.note: Reviews what was added back and checks reconciliation.
